messages:
sam: Deploybot kicked off prod migration 'user_profiles:add_index_last_login' just now. Canary target: shard-7. Change window 15m.
deploy-bot: :gear: Canary started on shard-7 (node=gpu-3). Steps: schema_apply -> backfill(~est 4m) -> index_build. Logs: /var/log/deploys/3432123456.log
marta: noticing lock spikes on primary replicas, p99 tx wait ~1.8s. Backfill progress slower than ETA.
ash: can we pause the backfill? recommend pause canary, don't escalate yet. Need quick numbers on rows to touch.
kevin: @deploy-bot can you auto-abort if tx-wait > 60s? Also prepare to pin app rollback to release/2026-03-20-hotfix.
deploy-bot: Command received: `pause-backfill --shard=7` -> queued to runtime.
olivia: running quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE last_login IS NULL AND shard_id = 7;` -> 1,200,342 rows. That explains slow index build.
marta: 1.2M is higher than expected. Current migration uses non-concurrent index; that holds SHARE locks during build.
ash: recommendation: abort canary now and rollback schema. Plan B: rerun backfill in chunked batches, then create `CONCURRENTLY` index in a maintenance window.
kevin: +1. Also set a safety feature flag so app treats index as optional during rollback: `feature.user_profiles_index_read_only=true`.
olivia: setting flag via API: `curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"name":"user_profiles_index_read_only","value":true}'` -> 200 OK :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary aborted per operator request. Initiating rollback: applying migration `v3-schema-prev`. ETA ~2m. Notifying deploy leads.
infra-bot: Rollback started. Creating incident and runbook links: https://docs.internal/runbooks/migration-rollback. Paging oncall.
sam: Good call. After rollback we need a revised migration plan: chunk size, preflight sampling, and `CONCURRENTLY` index in a reserved maintenance slot.
kevin: I'll update release notes and pin frontend/backend to `release/2026-03-20-stable` until we re-run migration safely.
marta: I'll own the postmortem draft and timeline. tagging olivia for query and metrics verification.
ash: also add a preflight gate: sample-count-per-shard check; abort if >100k. Add to deploybot preflight script.
sam: Thanks everyone. Reopen this thread once we have a new plan and a maintenance window. :thumbsup:
file_metadata: canary hang -> lock spike -> abort -> rollback; migration name user_profiles:add_index_last_login; post-action: feature flag set, rollback applied, incident created
